human_authority_review.authority_boundary: Only root actually receiving a direct human M-BOUND1 approval in the active conversation authorizes the numerical card. An automatic goal continuation, old approval, prepared tool/source receipt, JSON assertion, status file or the existence of evidence.json does not grant that approval.
human_authority_review.record_authorization_role: Audit writer only: it requires root-supplied actual reply/context/card/source evidence, clean published main, exact protocol and45 pins, no launch/run/stop objects, and original unexecuted source-publication proof. It copies the actual reply/proof and records original evidence SHA; it does not fabricate an answer or invoke the launcher.
human_authority_review.wording_contract: The actual raw human answer and its context are preserved; there is no fixed approval-wording requirement. A brief approval to the specific pending card can therefore be recorded after root establishes its human source and intended scope.
human_authority_review.trust_limit: The scripts cannot cryptographically authenticate a human conversation from a self-authored JSON file. Their identity/True/SHA checks are record consistency only. Passing those checks is never a substitute for root actually receiving and judging the direct human approval. Root must not construct the evidence object as a way to bypass the pending approval.
human_authority_review.historical_flags: Original protocol and source-publication prepared/authorized=false/executed=false flags remain frozen history. Actual future approval is a separate record made before launch; they are not silently rewritten.

tool_findings.finding: Reads only genuine future original approval/launch/helper/output/source-proof records before any report write. It checks published source/protocol/pins, unique successful invocation/exit/no-stop and original resources, original saved node/category text and CSV/JSON equality, and saved existing gate fields. It does not decode NPZ, import/run candidate, replay bincount/pattern, recompute L1/fsum/integrals or claim new force/physics qualification.
tool_findings.scope_boundaries: Original Hu pattern/scatter and old node-L1/new local-L1 remain recorded worker evidence. The reviewer compares saved errors to their saved bounds without producing an independent scientific oracle. Output field/API counts and no-retry assertions remain source/receipt/unique-file evidence, not independent mechanics instrumentation.
tool_findings.last_preparation_corrections: PNG signature/IHDR header/output names/raw SHA remain integrity checks; actual and source nominal dimensions are descriptive with no exact-size gate. Exact protocol PASS JSON appears once; other JSON/text/warnings remain descriptive, no total-line-count gate. Only JSONDecodeError is handled as non-JSON log text; other reader failures propagate.

tool_findings.finding: Requires actual approved unique successful run, matching hashes/calls/outputs and future terminal/physical/visual reports before copying root-authored actual RESULTS/NEXT_STEP/current prose. It archives reports/raw source/checklist and fully preserves source front-body history. Missing/failed records cannot create success docs during preparation. No scientific operations or production-source changes occur.

Requires future genuine authorization/raw reply SHA, successful unique receipts/ten outputs, actual terminal/physical/visual review, actual documentation receipt and final actual-results delivery static review. It must find the source proof already archived before execution and byte-equal to original publication; it contains no fallback that creates missing proof afterwards.
tool_findings.prepared_vs_actual_review: The exact future final_delivery_static_review status/actual repository and external SHA dictionaries are distinct from this tool preparation report. This report cannot satisfy that actual final review.

tool_findings.finding: Incremental finalize permits only three front-document replacements and new files inside this card stage, rejects deletion/other old-file changes, and inherits old manifest entries and science metadata. It checks immutable source/protocol/resource/card, actual approvals/reviews/outputs/text-history pins. Verify requires one source child commit, matching remote main, clean correct-origin source/restore and exact increment/old-entry inheritance; no force, numerical invocation, NPZ decoding or render is included.

This is a CURRENT ordinary source/readiness checker, separate from future terminal review. After this static pass it may verify frozen external byte SHA/AST, clean original source and45 raw bindings, no auth/run and no future actual report/config, then write an EXTERNAL prepared-not-authorized-not-executed receipt. It imports/executes none of the reviewed tools, creates no authorization, and edits no formal repository.
tool_findings.scope_limit: It was not run in this static audit. A later preparation receipt from it remains a source-readiness record, never numerical authorization or execution PASS.

tool_findings.finding: Explicit preparation/unapproved distinction, original resource/no-retry contract and proper weak-action/reference-image semantics are maintained. The checklist separates five owner roles from seven node categories, preserves old/new L1 definitions and24-state HP original body-force reference, and adds no pressure/energy/grip or cross-partition equality gate.

unchanged_scope_and_qualification.resource_contract: Frozen helper180s,outer240s,sampled8GiB; no extension, retry, repair rerun or force. Separate sampled RSS maxima are not hard caps or an ordering proof.
unchanged_scope_and_qualification.source_contract: Published main eb68c00 and exact protocol f27d201b /45 pins remain the fixed numerical source. Review and delivery wrappers do not silently change baseline, candidate, original inputs, scientific formula or original acceptance definitions.
unchanged_scope_and_qualification.physical_contract: Future physical report interprets actual saved two-state weak vertex actions without a new science gate. Five-role/corner/whole comparisons remain descriptive, original material/total text is preserved and no total=material+Hu reconstruction is introduced.
unchanged_scope_and_qualification.qualification_contract: Existing24-state/48HP total/material/Hu workpiece force/holding reference is retained. New saved Hu endpoint/corner interpretation does not qualify continuous pressure, unique face allocation, effective grip, mesh/domain/alpha physical stability, free workpiece/friction or wholeHF5.
unchanged_scope_and_qualification.visual_contract: PNG metadata/hash checks do not replace actual pixel inspection. Only selected endpoints are ON-body; others are negative local covectors. Reference geometry and independent display scales remain explicit; existing actual deformation GIF is reused.

limits: Static preparedness pass only. No approval or actual execution/result PASS is created. Future tools remain conditional on direct human authority and genuine later artifacts; any changed frozen tool bytes require corresponding static review.
